t: What He says in the last part of the night
a: هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ يُعْطَى هَلْ مِنْ دَاعٍ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهُ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الصُّبْحُ
p: Hal min sāʾilin yuʿṭā, hal min dāʿin yustajābu lah, hal min mustaghfirin yughfaru lah, ḥattā yanfajira-ṣ-ṣubḥ
m: Is there anyone asking, so he may be given? Anyone calling, so he may be answered? Anyone seeking forgiveness, so he may be forgiven? Until dawn breaks.
